portable.common_cut: After all initial plain dirty compensation reads and all frozen kernel setups, before the first source injection. Per-entry latest-read cuts also legal because every first non-read use is later than the entire plain-read block.
portable.scope: Exact signed prefix, parity response relations, cut ordering, physical stream mapping and new relation selections. This is not a newly replayed complete physical word. Bank charts, whole-word scalar/finite bounds and assembler admission need independent certificates.
